topic: Someone finds their partner's bucket list
text: I can't believe I stumbled upon this. It was hidden away like some kind of secret, a journal of dreams and aspirations that were never shared with me. We've been together for years, through every up and down, and yet, this list of desires and adventures, it's all new to me. Each item, carefully penned as if in preparation for a life we were never meant to share. It's like finding out there's a whole chapter in the story of their life that I've been left out of. I wonder if they ever thought to ask if I wanted to read the pages they've been writing. Maybe it's time to start a conversation about why secrets are kept in a relationship that's supposed to be built on trust.
